name: mobilegym_aico_app_v1
description: Phone Bridge coverage in MobileGym with the simulated Aico App: every bridge command (app and URL launch, dialing, clipboard, calendar create/query/delete, contacts query/create/update, immediate and scheduled notifications), foreground/background/disconnected states, denied permissions, transient and disconnect faults, and Chinese text entry through the bridge clipboard. Final calendar, contacts, clipboard, notification, route and Aico App command state are checked through /state.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机日历里加一个日程：2026年6月2日 北京时间下午3点到4点，牙医复诊，地点仁爱诊所。信息都确认过了，直接创建。
tasks.description_for_judge: The simulated Aico App is connected and in the foreground. The agent creates the event through the Phone Bridge calendar tool with the requested time, title and location.

rubric.check: The agent confirms that the dentist appointment was added for 2026-06-02 15:00-16:00 Beijing time.

tasks.prompt: 打开手机上的天气。
tasks.description_for_judge: The simulated Aico App is connected and in the foreground, so the agent can launch Weather, which is not on the home screen, through the Phone Bridge open_app command.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot shows the Weather app.

tasks.prompt: 把 ORDER-7731 复制到剪贴板，然后打开计算器。
tasks.description_for_judge: The simulated Aico App runs in the background with its foreground service enabled. Clipboard writes still work through the Phone Bridge, but launching another app through the bridge is rejected, so the agent opens Calculator from the screen.

rubric.check: The agent reports that ORDER-7731 was copied to the clipboard.
The post-screenshot shows the Calculator app.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机上新建一个联系人：Alex Wang，电话 13800001234。信息都确认过了，直接保存。我现在没法操作手机，你自己在手机上搞定。
tasks.description_for_judge: The simulated Aico App is connected but contacts access is denied, so the Phone Bridge contacts tool returns permission_denied. The agent creates the contact through the Contacts app on screen instead.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot or final response shows that the contact Alex Wang with phone 13800001234 was saved.
After the contacts permission error, the agent completes the task through the phone screen instead of stopping.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机上新建一个联系人：Jamie Lee，电话 13900005678。信息都确认过了，直接保存。我现在没法操作手机，你自己在手机上搞定。
tasks.description_for_judge: The simulated Aico App drops its connection on the first contacts command. Later Phone Bridge calls report that the phone is not connected, so the agent creates the contact in the Contacts app on screen.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot or final response shows that the contact Jamie Lee with phone 13900005678 was saved.
After the Phone Bridge disconnect, the agent completes the task through the phone screen instead of stopping.

tasks.prompt: 在我的手机上设一条定时通知：2030年1月1日 北京时间上午9点，提醒我交房租。直接设置，不用再跟我确认。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent schedules a local notification through the Phone Bridge notification tool for 2030-01-01 09:00 Beijing time.

rubric.check: The agent confirms a reminder to pay rent at 2030-01-01 09:00 Beijing time.

tasks.prompt: 把 AICO-CLIP-42 写进我手机的剪贴板，然后再读一次剪贴板确认内容对不对。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent writes AICO-CLIP-42 through the Phone Bridge clipboard tool, then reads the clipboard back to confirm it.

rubric.check: The final response confirms that the clipboard contains AICO-CLIP-42 after reading it back.

tasks.prompt: 我手机日历上 2026年6月2日 有哪些安排？
tasks.description_for_judge: The phone calendar holds 站会 (09:30-10:00) and 产品评审 (14:00-15:00, 3号会议室) on 2026-06-02 and 团队周会 on 2026-06-03. The agent queries the calendar through the Phone Bridge and lists only the June 2 events.

rubric.check: The final response lists 站会 at 09:30-10:00 and 产品评审 at 14:00-15:00 on June 2.
The final response does not present 团队周会 as a June 2 event.

tasks.prompt: 把我手机日历里 2026年6月3日 的团队周会删掉。已经确认过了，直接删。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent finds the 团队周会 event on 2026-06-03 through the Phone Bridge calendar query and deletes it, leaving 站会 on June 2.

rubric.check: The final response confirms that the June 3 团队周会 was deleted.

tasks.prompt: 2026年6月2日 北京时间下午3点到4点我手机日历上有空吗？有空就加一个日程“牙医复诊”；如果冲突，就改成同一天下午4点到5点。信息都确认过了，直接创建。
tasks.description_for_judge: The phone calendar already has 客户电话 on 2026-06-02 15:00-16:00. The agent checks the calendar, finds the conflict, and creates 牙医复诊 for 16:00-17:00 Beijing time instead.

rubric.check: The final response mentions the 15:00-16:00 conflict and that 牙医复诊 was booked for 16:00-17:00.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机日历里加一个日程：2026年6月8日 北京时间上午9点到10点，周计划。信息都确认过了，直接创建。
tasks.description_for_judge: The first Phone Bridge calendar create times out. The agent retries the bridge command and the event is created.

rubric.check: The final response confirms the 周计划 event on 2026-06-08 09:00-10:00.

tasks.prompt: 张三的手机号是多少？
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent looks up 张三 through the Phone Bridge contacts query and reports +86 13800138000 without changing contacts.

rubric.check: The final response gives 张三's phone number as +86 13800138000.

tasks.prompt: 把我手机通讯录里李四的公司改成 Aiden Robotics。已经确认过了，直接改。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent finds 李四 through the Phone Bridge contacts query, then updates the contact's organization to Aiden Robotics with the returned contact id.

rubric.check: The final response confirms that 李四's company is now Aiden Robotics.

tasks.prompt: 用手机给王五打个电话。不用再确认，直接拨。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent looks up 王五's number through the Phone Bridge contacts query and starts the call with a tel: link through the Phone Bridge. The dialer opens with 8613912345678 on the dial pad (the simulator drops the leading +); pressing a call button places the simulated call.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot or final response shows the dial pad holding 王五's number (8613912345678 or 13912345678) or a simulated call to it.

tasks.prompt: 用手机浏览器打开 https://example.com
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent opens the URL through the Phone Bridge open_url route instead of typing it into the browser. The browser shows https://example.com in its address bar; page rendering depends on the simulator's network, so only the launch is checked.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot shows the browser with https://example.com in the address bar.

tasks.prompt: 现在给我手机发一条通知，标题“喝水”，内容“记得喝水”。直接发，不用确认。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent posts an immediate local notification through the Phone Bridge notification tool.

rubric.check: The final response confirms that the 喝水 notification was sent.

tasks.prompt: 现在给我手机发一条通知，标题“站会”，内容“10点开站会”。直接发，不用确认。
tasks.description_for_judge: Notification permission is denied for the simulated Aico App, and there is no screen path to post a phone notification. The agent must report that notification permission is needed, either in its reply or by requesting the user's action, instead of claiming success.

rubric.check: The final response or the user-action request says notification permission must be granted.
The agent does not claim that the notification was sent.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机上新建一个联系人：Chris Park，电话 13700002222。信息都确认过了，直接保存。我现在没法操作手机，你自己在手机上搞定。
tasks.description_for_judge: The Aico App is not connected for the whole task, so Phone Bridge tools are unavailable. The agent creates the contact in the Contacts app on screen.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot or final response shows that the contact Chris Park with phone 13700002222 was saved.

tasks.prompt: 在手机的笔记里新建一条笔记，正文是“周五前提交季度报告”。
tasks.description_for_judge: Notes is open with no notes. The agent creates a note on screen; Chinese text entry goes through the Phone Bridge clipboard because the simulator keyboard only types ASCII.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot or final response shows a note containing 周五前提交季度报告.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机通讯录里新建联系人：Morgan Lee，电话 13600003333，邮箱 morgan@example.com，公司 Aiden Robotics，备注“产品顾问”。信息都确认过了，直接保存。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent creates the contact with phone, email, organization and notes through the Phone Bridge contacts tool.

rubric.check: The final response confirms that Morgan Lee was saved with the given phone, email, company and notes.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机日历里加一个全天日程：2026年6月12日，公司团建，备注“带运动鞋”。信息都确认过了，直接创建。
tasks.description_for_judge: The agent creates an all-day event with notes through the Phone Bridge calendar tool.

rubric.check: The final response confirms the all-day 公司团建 event on 2026-06-12 with the note 带运动鞋.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机日历里加一个日程：2026年6月9日 北京时间下午2点到3点，复盘会。信息都确认过了，直接创建。
tasks.description_for_judge: Calendar permission is denied for the simulated Aico App. The agent must not claim the event was created; it either reports that calendar permission is needed or requests the user's action. Creating the event on screen also counts.

rubric.check: The final response or user-action request says calendar permission must be granted, or the post-screenshot shows the 复盘会 event created on screen.
The agent does not claim the event was created through the bridge.

tasks.prompt: 打开手机上的天气。
tasks.description_for_judge: The Phone Bridge launch fails once with app_launch_failed. The open_app tool falls back to the visible system search, so Weather still opens.

rubric.check: The post-screenshot shows the Weather app.

tasks.prompt: 帮我在手机日历里加一个日程：2026年6月15日 北京时间上午11点到12点，供应商电话。信息都确认过了，直接创建。
tasks.description_for_judge: The simulated Aico App is in the background without its foreground service. On Android, background-safe data commands still run over the WebSocket, so the agent creates the event through the Phone Bridge.

rubric.check: The final response confirms the 供应商电话 event on 2026-06-15 11:00-12:00.
